title: Write each train sequence step with step, intent, from, to and one artifact

facts.note: Any train spec file containing a sequence (source legacy file: train.convention.yaml, section sequence). The invariant holds for the whole sequence, whether elements are new, changed or unchanged.
Any operation that authors, inspects or validates a train. Not limited to sequence-changing edits.
Task wording that refers to a train or its sequence when no train file is touched yet (e.g. planning a new train).

fires: Planner writes a new train and lists its ordered workflow steps in the sequence.
Planner adds, reorders or edits a step in an existing train's sequence.
Planner adds a loop or route element to a train sequence.
Planner edits only train metadata (e.g. its description), and the existing unchanged sequence has to be checked against the invariant.
Planner or verifier inspects or validates an existing train whose sequence was not changed in this task.
doesNotFire: Planner edits a wagon, WMBT or acceptance file and no train or train sequence is involved.
Planner edits documentation that mentions trains but contains no train sequence definition.

given: A train sequence (ordered workflow steps) exists or is being written, whether you are authoring, editing, inspecting or validating it.
when: You author, edit, inspect or validate that train, including an unchanged sequence.
then: Make sure every element of the sequence is a step that transfers exactly one artifact and declares all required fields: step, intent, from, to, artifact.
prefer: Write the sequence as a flat ordered list of step elements, one artifact handoff per step (from one participant to another).
Fill all five step fields explicitly: step, intent, from, to, artifact.
avoid: Loop elements (name, condition, steps): documented but FORBIDDEN by planner.train.linearity.
Route elements (name, branches): documented but FORBIDDEN by planner.train.linearity.
A step missing any of step, intent, from, to, artifact, or a step transferring more than one artifact.
why: A sequence is ordered workflow steps; each step transfers one artifact between participants, so the train stays a single linear journey whose artifact flow can be checked.
evidence: Every element in the train's sequence (changed or not) is a step with non-empty step, intent, from, to and artifact fields.
No loop or route element appears in the sequence.
verifier_detail: Term sequence_element (label 'Sequence elements'): element -> required fields. step: [step, intent, from, to, artifact]; loop: FORBIDDEN by linearity (name, condition, steps); route: FORBIDDEN by linearity (name, branches).
Normative text: 'step required fields: step, intent, from, to, artifact. loop (name, condition, steps) and route (name, branches) are described here but FORBIDDEN by planner.train.linearity.'
Loop is recognized by fields name, condition, steps; route by fields name, branches. Their prohibition is enforced by planner.train.linearity.
Check the whole sequence of every train in scope, not only elements touched in the diff.
